description: This header file provides helper functions for default configuration generation and validation related to 5G CU-CP (Central Unit - Control Plane) configurations, including QoS settings, security, and mobility validation.

methods.name: make_default_cu_cp_qos_config_list
methods.description: Generates a default list of QoS configurations for different 5QI values used by gNB CU-CP, covering guaranteed and non-guaranteed bitrates, with specific timer and delivery settings.

methods.name: make_default_cu_cp_config
methods.description: Creates a default CU-CP configuration including bearer QoS settings and security preferences.

methods.name: is_valid_configuration
methods.description: Validates a CU-CP or mobility configuration, checking for non-empty node names and valid mobility settings.

methods.name: get_supported_plmns
methods.description: Extracts supported PLMN identities from a list of NGAP configurations.
